label: C=S box, first discharge (insertion order 0) then charge removing the cheapest lithium first, 3.0 V cutoff. This order traps 25 %; the mean over 5 removal orders on the poster is 74 mAh/g (18 %).

pocket.note: pocket = the ring nitrogens around the lithium removed at the highest charge voltage (3.71 V); it fills at about 84 mAh/g on discharge and stays occupied until the charge branch passes 3.0 V. Occupancy is evaluated per frame (any Li within 2.45 Å of at least two of these N), because lithium atoms exchange during the anneals.
